note: Where Comet is and where it is going. Edit this file to update the roadmap on cometmesh.org; status is done, now or next.

items.title: Forked from wadamesh, renamed throughout
items.text: Own name, own repository, own logo; credits to wadamesh and MeshCore stay.

items.title: Audiobooks and e-books
items.text: Audiobookshelf streaming and downloads, books copied onto the SD card, an EPUB reader.

items.title: The Comet mark
items.text: A comet whose tail is a mesh, drawn and animated the same way on every screen, e-paper included.

items.title: ESP-IDF 5.5 for the T-Deck Max
items.text: Arduino 3.3 on a current ESP-IDF: about 80 KB more free memory and downloads three to four times faster. In testing on the device.

items.title: A board layer
items.text: Every board in one folder behind fixed interfaces, so a new device is a day of work instead of a week.

items.title: T-LoRa Pager on the new base
items.text: The first board to come over through the board layer.

items.title: Releases and a web installer
items.text: Built by CI, installed from the browser, updated over Wi-Fi from our own servers.

items.title: SMS and calls on the T-Deck Max
items.text: The A7682E modem: text messages, voice calls and mobile data, for when there is no mesh.

items.title: Every mesh
items.text: Meshtastic next to MeshCore on the same radio, with one screen to pick the active mesh.

items.title: A new interface
items.text: Comet's own UI on LVGL 9, designed for small screens and e-paper first.

items.title: More boards
items.text: Once the board layer has proven itself on the Pager.
